name: qa-playground
description: Plataforma educacional para prática de testes de software

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:site && npm run build:css && npm run build:ts && npm run build:ts:api
scripts.watch: concurrently -n site,css,ts "npm run watch:site" "npm run watch:css" "npm run watch:ts"
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n site,css,ts,api-ts,api,web "npm run watch:site" "npm run watch:css" "npm run watch:ts" "npm run watch:ts:api" "npm run serve:api" "npm run serve"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:ts:api && npm run serve:api
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web "npm run serve:api" "npm run serve"
scripts.test:api: npm run build:ts:api && node tools/qa/api-smoke.mjs --compare tools/qa/baseline/api-smoke.json
scripts.qa: npm run build && npm run qa:dom && npm run qa:links && node tools/qa/api-smoke.mjs --compare tools/qa/baseline/api-smoke.json

author: David Nascimento
